question.asked: Conditional on a frozen shared-transition component, does a frozen maturation-specific component add information about an independently measured mature AT1 contribution, in independent animals?
what_is_not_being_asked: whether a maturation-specific programme exists as a separable biological entity
whether mature AT1 identity is an extension of the transitional state
whether any RNA score predicts any other RNA score

founding_observation.content: source-derived ADI and AT1 holdout lists share 119 genes; the four-gene late-AT1 panel changes direction across technical seeds 17 and 29 at 2,000 UMIs in several injured wells and the one eligible external mouse
founding_observation.licenses: a measurement check: freeze a disjoint component partition before any endpoint is opened

predictions.if_h1_holds: the frozen maturation component adds information about the measured mature endpoint beyond the shared component, and the increment transports
predictions.if_the_measurement_rival_holds: the increment disappears under a disjoint partition
predictions.non_identifiability: a shrinking increment after disjointification is consistent with both the measurement rival and removal of real shared biology; neither direction is identified by RNA alone

contents: explicit rule assigning the 119 overlapping genes
exclusion of the seed-unstable four-gene late-AT1 panel from a primary role

conditions_all_required: mature AT1 contribution measured independently of RNA (protein, morphology or traced descendant yield)
an early epithelial RNA measurement in the same biological units as the endpoint
predictor timing documented as earlier than the endpoint
at least three independent animals, donors or preparations per arm with identities deposited
endpoint definition independent of the predictor's genes
stage_2_eligibility_gate.state_on_2026_09_28: no candidate identified; no public-data search has been performed under this gate

prohibitions: defining predictor and mature outcome from the same or overlapping RNA panels
using the four-gene late-AT1 panel as a primary instrument while it is seed-unstable
substituting organoid size, a cycling score or a transitional score for measured mature AT1 contribution
reassigning the 119 shared genes after an increment has been seen
pooling preparations or relaxing the three-unit floor
boundaries: A10's organoid endpoint is concurrent with its RNA and its unit is the well; it is not A8's later outcome
no EdU, BrdU or label-retention assay is named in the surveyed evidence, so a traced-yield readout cannot be assumed available
discriminating_measurement: one cohort with an early epithelial RNA profile and, at a later documented timepoint, mature AT1 contribution measured by protein or traced descendant yield
